translations.web: It was shown to you so that you might know that Yahweh is God. There is no one else besides him.
translations.bsb: You were shown these things so that you would know that the LORD is God; there is no other besides Him.
translations.kjv: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.
translations.asv: Unto thee it was showed, that thou mightest know that Jehovah he is God; there is none else besides him.
